name: Majority Completion Laws
statement: Majority closure commutes with projection and Cartesian product and satisfies $\operatorname{med}(C[\tau])\subseteq\operatorname{med}(C)[\tau]$. Its defect decreases under nonempty pc-minors and its completed size is multiplicative on products.
proof: Majority terms commute with projections and preserve fixed coordinates. Closing the product one factor at a time proves exact product commutation. Missing completed concepts after projection or conditioning inject into those before the operation.
